src='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); bg=max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda c:sum(row.count(c) for row in grid))
    seen=set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]!=bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            q=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]; outside=False
            while q:
                y,x=q.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                if y==0 or x==0 or y==h-1 or x==w-1: outside=True
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and grid[ny][nx]==bg and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((ny,nx)); q.append((ny,nx))
            if not outside:
                ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
                rh=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; rw=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
                color=2 if rh==rw and rh%2==0 and len(comp)==rh*rw else 7
                for y,x in comp: grid[y][x]=color
    return grid
'''
open(pdir+'/task-3cb0f1c1.py','w').write(src)
